text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, do you have your sweets ready~? 
Well theeeen—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Happy~ Valentine's~♪

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text:
"Happy V-Day~!!" "WOOOOOO↑↑" "Happy 
Valentine's~!!" "★☆Cheers☆★" "Happy 
V-Day!!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
What did you all bring today? ..."Bought 
cake from the department store basement"!?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"No way~! So jealous~! Where from, where 
from? ...Whoa, looks yummy~! I love the 
gateau chocolat from there too~♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Today is Valentine's Day. Loves Only 
You was hosting her annual Happy Valentine 
stream with her community members."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Every year on this stream, Loves Only You 
and her community members prepare their 
favorite snacks and chat away while 
enjoying them, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For a certain reason, I was watching 
today's stream with my heart pounding in 
my chest...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—As for the reason why, we have to go back 
a little bit.
choice_data_list:
"Wait, what?! Me giving chocolate to 
Loves?!"

"Wait, what?! Me giving chocolate to 
Loves?!"

text_block_list.name: Easily Bored Girl
text_block_list.text:
"Yes! Representing the community members, 
we want you to give Loves-chan the 
ultimate chocolate!!"

text_block_list.name: Hardworker@Overseas Assignment
text_block_list.text:
"Opportunities like this are super rare 
for us too...! Please, make sure 
Loves-chan feels our support!"

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Gym Bro
text_block_list.text:
"You're the only one who can serve as this 
bridge. Everyone here knows that you've 
poured more of your heart and soul into 
her than anyone else."

text_block_list.name: Passionate Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"We're all equally part of this community. 
But if we had to pick just one person, as 
much as it pains me to say, it's gotta be 
you...!"

text_block_list.name: Community Members
text_block_list.text:
"Please!" "It's unanimous!" "Make her 
happy on the big day!" "We're counting on 
you!!" "You can do it, Bridge-san!" 
"Rooting for you!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And so, entrusted with the feelings of 
the community members, I set out to 
prepare the chocolate to give to Loves 
Only You.
choice_data_list: Um, so this is the right amount...

text_block_list.name: Community Members
text_block_list.text:
"Good, good!" "The practice is paying 
off!" "Just a little more, you can do it!" 
"Looks delicious." "Loves-chan's gonna 
love this too."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watched over by the commu-members, 
learning from them at times, and putting 
everyone's feelings into making it—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...And that brings us to the present. 
During this stream, I plan to find the 
right moment to surprise her with it."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Now then, with the party livening up... 
Time for a surpri~se!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer-chan.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: —Happy Valentine's Day!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"...Thank you for all your love, always♡ I 
put my heart into making this, so please 
enjoy♪"

text_block_list.name: Easily Bored Girl
text_block_list.text: "Darn it—!! They got the jump on me—!!"

text_block_list.name: Passionate Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"Dammit! Knowing Loves-chan's personality, 
this development was definitely on the 
table...!!"

text_block_list.name: Community Members
text_block_list.text:
"Go, Bridge!!" "Now's the time!!" "Right 
now!" "GO GO GO GO GO GO" "Give it your 
all!!" "Don't give up—!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, look, everyone♪ Trainer-kun looks so 
surprised—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, look, everyone♪ Trainer-chan looks 
so surprised—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
......Huh, what's that? What do you mean, 
"don't lose"......

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Ehh—
choice_data_list:
From the community members, and from me— 
thank you as always.

From the community members, and from me— 
thank you as always.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
So... Sorry! I was just, well, a little 
startled...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Did everyone... already know...?

text_block_list.name: Community Members
text_block_list.text:
"We're accomplices!" "We surprised them 
too much!" "Bridge builder did it!" 
"Surprise success!" "Yaaaay!! We're the 
bad kids!"

text_block_list.name: Community Members
text_block_list.text:
""From us to Loves-chan!" "The 
bridge-builder worked really hard to make 
this!" "Well done!!" "Nice!!""

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: "From us to Loves-chan"...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Everyone—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I'm so happy...! It's soo full of love... 
I'm truly the happiest!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
And to think, this chocolate was made by 
Trainer-kun—
choice_data_list:
It wasn't just me. I borrowed everyone's 
strength.
It wasn't just me. I had everyone's help.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
And to think, this chocolate was made by 
Trainer-chan—
choice_data_list:
It wasn't just me. I borrowed everyone's 
strength.
It wasn't just me. I had everyone's help.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I see...! It's packed full of 
everyone's and Trainer-kun's feelings...♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I see...! It's packed full of 
everyone's and Trainer-chan's feelings...♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you so, so much...! I've never had 
such a lovely Valentine's in my entire 
life...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Loves Only You looks happy from the bottom 
of her heart, and her community members 
are thrilled too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...For me as well, it turned out to be 
the greatest Valentine's Day possible."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Loves Only You looks happy from the bottom 
of her heart, and her community members 
are thrilled too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...For me as well, it turned out to be 
the greatest Valentine's Day possible."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After the Valentine's stream finished and 
all the clean-up was done—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun♡ I have a little favor to ask, 
though~...—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer-chan♡ I have a little favor to 
ask, you see..."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Can I eat the chocolate you just gave me 
right now? I'm so curious about how it 
tastes!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Really? Then—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Mm.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Jeez, don't you get it?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I'm telling you to feed me♪ Come on, like 
saying "Say aah!"
choice_data_list:
N-No, no, no, no, that's really going too 
far...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Geez! I said I want you to do it, so it's 
fine! Or would you rather—"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Would you rather I feed you an 'aahhn' 
first, Trainer-kun?
choice_data_list: WHY DOES IT TURN OUT LIKE THIS!?
WHY DOES IT TURN OUT LIKE THIS!?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Would you rather I feed you an 'aahhn' 
first, Trainer-chan?
choice_data_list: WHY DOES IT TURN OUT LIKE THIS!?
WHY DOES IT TURN OUT LIKE THIS!?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Ehh? We gave each other chocolates, so 
that's definitely way more romantic, don't 
you think?♪"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
By the way, you're aaaabsolutely going to 
do this for me, okay?♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
You have to take responsibility for making 
me cry emotional tears in front of 
everyone! ♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Now, give it up, Trainer-kun! Are you 
giving or getting the "say ahh" first!?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Now, give it up, Trainer-chan! Are you 
giving or getting the "say ahh" first!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Loves Only You and I ended up 
happily eating each other's chocolates—
